description: Change one Model Access rule of the connected project's workspace: which models the whole wallet (account), one team member, one API key (project), one way in (surface) or one agent may run. A rule names categories, single models (by owner/slug) and what every other model gets (everything_else). update changes only the entries it names and keeps the rest (access unset takes an entry out), replace writes the whole rule, remove deletes it. Every rule that applies to a run must allow its model, so a narrower rule cannot open what a wider one blocks. Only the account owner, a team admin or the organization's owner can change rules; for anyone else this changes nothing. Without `confirm: true` it returns a change summary: the rule before and after, each entry that changes, and warnings, such as a wider rule that still blocks a model it allows. Show it, wait for a clear yes, then repeat the call exactly as its nextAction shows. If the rule changed in between, or the call asks for anything else, nothing is saved and a new summary comes back.

action.description: update merges the entries given into the rule, replace writes the whole rule from the entries given, remove deletes the rule.

agent.description: Scope agent: the deployed agent, by name or guid. Its rule also covers the chat model it answers with and its built-in voice (voice notes and voice replies, which count as Audio & Speech).

categories.description: Categories: image, video, audio, music, 3d, llm, utilities. A category also covers models added to it later; within a rule a model's own entry wins, then a block among its categories. unset, with update only, takes the entry out.

confirm.description: Set true only by repeating the change summary's nextAction, after the user approved that summary.

everything_else.description: What every model the rule names neither by category nor by name gets. allow: every model except what the rule blocks; block: only what the rule allows. update keeps it when left out; replace and a new rule default to allow.

member.description: Scope member, teams only: the member, by e-mail or user id.

models.description: Single models, up to 50 a call (a rule holds up to 500). unset, with update only, takes the entry out.

model.description: owner/slug as search_models shows it, or the model's id.

project.description: Scope project: the API key's project, by id or exact name. Left out, this connection's own key.

rule_guid.description: The rule's guid from get_controls, in place of scope and its target.

scope.description: Whose runs the rule covers: account (the whole wallet), member (one team member), project (one API key), surface (one way in) or agent (one deployed agent). Needed unless rule_guid names the rule.

summary_id.description: From the change summary's nextAction: the id of the change the user saw. Never set it yourself.

surface.description: Scope surface: web (the dashboard), api (an API key, a local install of this server included), mcp (the hosted MCP server), llm-gateway, extension or agent.

updated_at.description: From the change summary's nextAction: the version of the rule the user saw. Never set it yourself.
